UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user of the DataCube AU application.

storageQuotaBytes.description: The user's storage quota in bytes.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Represents a document uploaded by a user, including its status and processed content.

fileName.description: The original filename of the uploaded document.

filePath.description: The full path to the file in Supabase Storage.

fileSizeBytes.description: The size of the file in bytes.

parentId.description: For sub-documents, the ID of the parent main_textbook.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the document was created.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the document will expire.

DocumentChunk.title: Document Chunk
DocumentChunk.description: A chunk of text from a processed document with its vector embedding.

text.description: The text content of the chunk.

embedding.description: The vector embedding of the chunk's text.

CachedResponse.title: Cached AU Response
CachedResponse.description: Caches responses from the AU to avoid repeated API calls for the same question.

/users/{userId}/documents/{documentId}.description: Stores documents uploaded by the user.

/users/{userId}/documents/{documentId}/c.description: Stores text chunks and their embeddings for a document.
